directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on online libraries. You can start your essay with the sentence "Online libraries are becoming increasingly popular". You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Online libraries are becoming increasingly popular. To begin with, they offer unparalleled convenience. Users can access a vast collection of books, journals, and other materials from anywhere with an internet connection, eliminating the need to visit a physical library. For example, a student can study late at night without leaving their dormitory.

In addition, online libraries provide a wider range of resources. They can house materials from all over the world, including rare and out-of-print books. This gives users more options to explore different fields of knowledge.

Furthermore, they are cost-effective. Many online libraries offer free access to a large number of resources, which is especially beneficial for students and researchers on a budget.

In conclusion, the popularity of online libraries is well-deserved. Their convenience, extensive resources, and cost-effectiveness make them an essential tool for modern learning and research.
